page.layout: One printed page, title page, centred. Top: title block in large capitals and italics. Middle: woodcut of a book with clouds in a circle. Below: imprint and date line. Handwritten marks and a stamp-like scribble are not printed text.

l.i: de S. Scripturae in Philosophicis abusu.

main_text.l: Adjunctâ refutatione argumenti ab eodem authore ex Cartesii Principiis pro Motu Terrae desumpti.

page.notes: Woodcut vignette of an open book on a desk beneath clouds, within a circle, between the subtitle and the imprint. Manuscript ink flourishes and a handwritten word at the left and right of the "asserta" line are not printed text and were omitted. The "Quondam Duysburgi" line is printed with the "Quondam" word underlined by a hand-drawn mark, not part of the print. The date is printed as M. DC. LV. in small capitals with a reversed-style spacing.
